title: P1c fix round 1: recall() takes an explicit state root instead of resolving ORCH_ROOT or cwd at import time, so packets built against a test or foreign root find their notes and bus evidence (gate_red: test_packet_gotcha_match_by_path and test_scout_packet_bounded_tree_and_memory_titles_only print "(none)")
spec:
Fix round for T-0463 (P1c) on its branch task/T-0463 at 9e4257e. The daemon's gate is red and the failure reproduces alone: tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_gotcha_match_by_path and ::test_scout_packet_bounded_tree_and_memory_titles_only render "## gotchas (none)" and no memory titles because skills/planner/memory/scripts/recall.py fixes ROOT = ORCH_ROOT or Path.cwd() at import time (recall.py:7-11: MEM, TASKS, LESSONS module constants) and spawn.memory_recall (spawn.py:11-17, importlib from the file path) calls recall() without telling it which state root the packet is being built for, so the notes and bus layers read the process root instead of the test's temporary STATE (spawn.STATE / bus.STATE are monkeypatched in tests; the fixture gotcha "Widget cache" and the memory title "Useful title" live there).
1. recall.recall(query, *, root=None, ...): root is the state root (the directory that contains .orchestrator); when None fall back to ORCH_ROOT or cwd as today (CLI use). Every layer derives its paths from that root per call (memory dir root/.orchestrator/memory, tasks root/.orchestrator/tasks, pool.toml, graphify-out or GRAPHIFY_OUT); the module-level constants remain only as CLI defaults. The bus layer reads task files under root rather than through bus.STATE, so a foreign root works; the log_run row still goes through bus.log_run.
2. spawn.memory_recall passes root=<the parent of spawn's STATE at call time> (STATE is monkeypatched in tests, so read it at call time, not at import), and the packet header's memory source names the layers as before.
3. Tests: the two failing tests pass unchanged; add tests/test_memory_skill.py::test_recall_uses_explicit_root_not_import_time_cwd (a temp root with a gotcha and a task result; ORCH_ROOT and cwd pointing elsewhere; recall(query, root=tmp, layers=("notes","bus")) returns hits from tmp only) and tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_memory_reads_from_monkeypatched_state (the packet gotchas section contains the fixture gotcha after STATE is redirected).
Keep every T-0463 test and all existing tests green; run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh in the worktree and confirm exit 0 (the previous run claimed green while the daemon's gate was red: run the full suite, not a subset); commit on task/T-0463's branch with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: recall() reads notes, bus, pool.toml and graph paths from an explicit root per call; spawn passes the current STATE's root
all T-0463 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
